in_hebrew.name: חלק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew root 'chalak' which means 'to cut' or 'to divide'. It can be interpreted as 'one who is given a portion' or 'one who is given a division'. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: χαλκων
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hallock may not have a direct Greek equivalent. However, it is similar to the Greek name 'Chalkon' which means 'bronze' or 'copper'. This name is also not found in the Bible.

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hallock does not have a direct Latin equivalent.
